title.zh: 卷四一 列傳第三三 暴顯 皮景和 鮮于世榮 綦連猛 元景安 獨孤永業 傅伏 高保寧
title.en: Volume 41 Biographies 33: Bao Xian; Pi Jinghe; Xianyu Shirong; Qilian Meng; Yuan Jing'an; Dugu Yongye; Fu Fu; Gao Baoning
title.raw: 卷四一 列傳第三三 暴顯 皮景和 鮮于世榮 綦連猛 元景安 獨孤永業 傅伏 高保寧 Volume 41 Biographies 33: Bao Xian; Pi Jinghe; Xianyu Shirong; Qilian Meng; Yuan Jing'an; Dugu Yongye; Fu Fu; Gao Baoning

sentences.zh: 暴顯 皮景和 鮮于世榮 綦連猛 元景安 獨孤永業 傅伏 高保寧

translations.literal: Bao Xian; Pi Jinghe; Xianyu Shirong; Qilian Meng; Yuan Jing'an; Dugu Yongye; Fu Fu; Gao Baoning
translations.idiomatic: Bao Xian; Pi Jinghe; Xianyu Shirong; Qilian Meng; Yuan Jing'an; Dugu Yongye; Fu Fu; Gao Baoning

sentences.zh: 暴顯，字思祖，魏郡斥邱人也。

translations.literal: Bao Xian, styled Sizu, was a man of Chiqiu in Wei commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Xian, styled Sizu, came from Chiqiu in Wei commandery.

sentences.zh: 祖喟，魏瑯邪太守、朔州刺史，因家邊朔。

translations.literal: His grandfather Kai was Wei governor of Langye and inspector of Shuozhou; the family then settled on the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Kai had been Wei governor of Langye and inspector of Shuozhou; the family then settled on the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 父誕，魏恒州刺史、左衛將軍，樂安公。

translations.literal: His father Dan was Wei inspector of Hengzhou and left guard general, Duke of Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: His father Dan was Wei inspector of Hengzhou and left guard general, Duke of Le'an.

sentences.zh: 顯幼時，見一沙門指之曰：「此郎子有好相表，大必為良將，貴極人臣。

translations.literal: When Xian was young he saw a monk point at him and say: "This lad has a fine physiognomy; in the end he will surely become a good general, noble to the utmost as a minister.
translations.idiomatic: When Xian was young a monk pointed at him and said, "This lad has a fine face; in the end he will surely become a good general, noble to the utmost among ministers.

sentences.zh: 」語終失僧，莫知所去。

translations.literal: " When the words ended the monk was lost; none knew where he had gone.
translations.idiomatic: " When the words ended the monk was gone; none knew where he had gone.

sentences.zh: 顯少經軍旅，善於騎射，曾從魏孝莊帝出獵，一日之中，手獲禽獸七十三。

translations.literal: Xian from youth had seen military service and was skilled at riding and archery; he once followed Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei on a hunt and in one day with his own hands took seventy-three birds and beasts.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Xian had seen military service and was skilled at riding and archery. He once followed Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei on a hunt and in one day took seventy-three birds and beasts with his own hands.

sentences.zh: 孝昌二年，除羽林監。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xiaochang he was made supervisor of the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the second Xiaochang year he was made supervisor of the feathered forest.

sentences.zh: 中興元年，除襄威將軍、晉州車騎府長史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongxing he was made General Who Displays Might and chief clerk of Jinzhou's chariot-and-horse office.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Zhongxing year he was made general who displays might and chief clerk of Jinzhou's chariot-and-horse office.

sentences.zh: 後從高祖於信都舉義，授中堅將軍、散騎侍郎、帳內大都督，加安東將軍、銀青光祿大夫，屯留縣開國侯。

translations.literal: Later he followed Gao Huan in raising the righteous army at Xindu and was appointed steadfast general, scattered cavalry attendant, great commander within the tent, additionally made general who pacifies the east and grand master with silver-blue-gleaming cap, and Marquis of Tunliu county with a state fief.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Gao Huan in raising the righteous army at Xindu and was appointed steadfast general, scattered-cavalry attendant, and great commander within the tent, with additional rank as general who pacifies the east and grand master with silver-blue-gleaming cap, and as marquis of Tunliu county with a state fief.

sentences.zh: 天平二年，除渤海郡守。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianping he was made administrator of Bohai commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second Tianping year he was made administrator of Bohai commandery.

sentences.zh: 元象元年，除雲州大中正，兼武衛將軍，加鎮東將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang he was made chief rectifier of Yunzhou, concurrently general of the martial guard, and additionally general who pacifies the east.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Yuanxiang year he was made chief rectifier of Yunzhou, concurrently general of the martial guard, with additional rank as general who pacifies the east.

sentences.zh: 二年，除北徐州刺史、當州大都督。

translations.literal: In the second year he was made inspector of Northern Xuzhou and grand commander of that province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made inspector of Northern Xuzhou and grand commander of that province.

sentences.zh: 從高祖與西師戰於邙山，高祖令顯守河橋鎮，據中潬城。

translations.literal: He followed Gao Huan in fighting the western army at Mount Mang; Gao Huan ordered Xian to hold Heqiao garrison and occupy Zhongyong city.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Gao Huan in fighting the western army at Mount Mang. Gao Huan ordered Xian to hold Heqiao garrison and occupy Zhongyong city.

sentences.zh: 武定二年，除征南將軍、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wuding he was made general who campaigns south and inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second Wuding year he was made general who campaigns south and inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 侯景反於河南，為景所攻，顯率左右二十餘騎突出賊營，拔難歸國。

translations.literal: Hou Jing rebelled in Henan and attacked him; Xian led a little more than twenty horsemen of his close guard and burst out of the rebel camp, broke through hardship, and returned to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing rebelled in Henan and attacked him. Xian led a little more than twenty horsemen of his close guard, burst out of the rebel camp, broke through hardship, and returned to the state.

sentences.zh: 時高岳、慕容紹宗等討景，即配顯士馬，隨岳等破景於渦陽。

translations.literal: At the time Gao Yue and Murong Shaozong and others were campaigning against Jing; they at once assigned Xian troops and horses, and he followed Yue and the rest in defeating Jing at Woyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Gao Yue, Murong Shaozong, and others were campaigning against Jing. They at once assigned Xian troops and horses, and he followed Yue and the rest in defeating Jing at Woyang.

sentences.zh: 武定六年，拜太府卿。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Wuding he was appointed director of the grand treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth Wuding year he was appointed director of the grand treasury.

sentences.zh: 從世宗平王思政於潁川，授潁州刺史。

translations.literal: He followed Gao Cheng in pacifying Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan and was appointed inspector of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Gao Cheng in pacifying Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan and was appointed inspector of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 七年，轉鄭州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to inspector of Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to inspector of Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年，加驃騎將軍，進侯為公，通前食邑一千三百戶。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was additionally made general of the swift cavalry; his marquisate was advanced to a duchy, and with prior fiefs the food households totaled one thousand three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was additionally made general of the swift cavalry; his marquisate was advanced to a duchy, and with prior fiefs the food households totaled one thousand three hundred.

sentences.zh: 天保元年，加衛大將軍，刺史如故。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianbao he was additionally made great general of the guards; his inspectorship was unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Tianbao year he was additionally made great general of the guards; his inspectorship was unchanged.

sentences.zh: 三年，與清河王高岳襲歷陽，取之。

translations.literal: In the third year, together with Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, he raided Liyang and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, together with Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, he raided Liyang and took it.

sentences.zh: 為贓貨，解鄭州，大理禁止。

translations.literal: For bribe goods he was removed from Zhengzhou and confined by the Court of Review.
translations.idiomatic: For taking bribes he was removed from Zhengzhou and confined by the court of review.

sentences.zh: 處斷未訖，為合肥被圍，遣與步汗薩、慕容儼等同攻梁北徐州。

translations.literal: Before the sentence was finished, Hefei was besieged; he was sent with Buhan Sa, Murong Yan, and others jointly to attack Liang's Northern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before the sentence was finished, Hefei was besieged; he was sent with Buhan Sa, Murong Yan, and others jointly to attack Liang's Northern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 擒刺史王強。

translations.literal: They captured Inspector Wang Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: They captured inspector Wang Qiang.

sentences.zh: 與梁秦州刺史嚴超達戰於涇城，破之。

translations.literal: They fought Liang's inspector of Qinzhou Yan Chaoda at Jingcheng and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: They fought Liang inspector of Qinzhou Yan Chaoda at Jingcheng and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 五年，授儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed equal in rank to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed equal in rank to the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 其年，又與高岳南臨漢水，攻下梁西楚州，獲刺史許法光。

translations.literal: That same year he again followed Gao Yue south to the Han River and attacked and took Liang's Western Chuzhou, capturing Inspector Xu Faguang.
translations.idiomatic: That same year he again followed Gao Yue south to the Han River, attacked and took Liang's Western Chuzhou, and captured inspector Xu Faguang.

sentences.zh: 于時梁將蕭循與侯瑱等圍慕容儼於郢州，復以顯為水軍大都督，從攝口入江救之。

translations.literal: At the time Liang generals Xiao Xun and Hou Zhen and others besieged Murong Yan at Yingzhou; Xian was again made grand commander of the water army and entered the river from Shekou to rescue him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Liang generals Xiao Xun and Hou Zhen and others besieged Murong Yan at Yingzhou. Xian was again made grand commander of the water army and entered the river from Shekou to rescue him.

sentences.zh: 師還，加開府儀同三司，賞帛五百疋。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was additionally made opener of the government with rank equal to the Three Excellencies and rewarded with five hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was additionally made opener of the government with rank equal to the three excellencies and rewarded with five hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 十年，食幽州范陽郡幹。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he drew salary from the dry fief of Fanyang commandery in Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he drew salary from the dry fief of Fanyang commandery in Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 乾明元年，除車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianming he was made great general of the chariots and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Qianming year he was made great general of the chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 皇建元年，轉封樂安郡開國公。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangjian his fief was changed to Duke of Le'an commandery with a state.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Huangjian year his fief was changed to duke of Le'an commandery with a state.

sentences.zh: 二年，除趙州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year he was made inspector of Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made inspector of Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 河清元年，遷洛州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Heqing he was moved to inspector of Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Heqing year he was moved to inspector of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 二年，復除朔州刺史，秩滿歸。

translations.literal: In the second year he was again made inspector of Shuozhou; when his term ended he returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was again made inspector of Shuozhou; when his term ended he returned home.

sentences.zh: 天統元年，加特進、驃騎大將軍，封定陽王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiantong he was specially advanced and made general of the swift cavalry, enfeoffed as Prince of Dingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Tiantong year he was specially advanced and made general of the swift cavalry, enfeoffed as prince of Dingyang.

sentences.zh: 四年卒，年六十六。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died, aged sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died, aged sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 皮景和，瑯邪下邳人也。

translations.literal: Pi Jinghe was a man of Xiapi in Langye.
translations.idiomatic: Pi Jinghe came from Xiapi in Langye.

sentences.zh: 父慶賓，魏淮南王開府中兵參軍事。

translations.literal: His father Qingbin was staff officer for military affairs in the establishment office of Wei Prince of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Qingbin was staff officer for military affairs in the establishment office of Wei Prince of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 正光中，因使懷朔，遇世亂，因家廣寧之石門縣。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguang era, while on mission to Huaishuo, he met the age's disorder and thereupon made his home in Shimen county of Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenguang era, while on mission to Huaishuo, he met the age's disorder and made his home in Shimen county of Guangning.

sentences.zh: 景和少通敏，善騎射。

translations.literal: Jinghe from youth was quick and perceptive and skilled at riding and archery.
translations.idiomatic: Jinghe from youth was quick and perceptive and skilled at riding and archery.

sentences.zh: 初以親信事高祖，後補親信副都督。

translations.literal: At first he served Gao Huan as a trusted intimate; later he was made deputy commander of trusted intimates.
translations.idiomatic: At first he served Gao Huan as a trusted intimate; later he was made deputy commander of trusted intimates.

sentences.zh: 武定二年，征步落稽。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wuding he campaigned against the Buroq.
translations.idiomatic: In the second Wuding year he campaigned against the Buroq.

sentences.zh: 世宗疑賊有伏兵，令景和將五六騎深入一谷中，值賊百餘人，便共格戰，景和射數十人，莫不應弦而倒。

translations.literal: Gao Cheng suspected the bandits had an ambush and ordered Jinghe to take five or six horsemen deep into one valley; they met more than a hundred bandits and at once joined battle. Jinghe shot several tens of men, and none failed to fall at the twang of the string.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Cheng suspected the bandits had laid an ambush and ordered Jinghe to take five or six horsemen deep into one valley. They met more than a hundred bandits and at once joined battle. Jinghe shot several tens of men, and none failed to fall at the twang of the string.

sentences.zh: 高祖嘗令景和射一野豕，一箭而獲之，深見嗟賞，除庫直正都督。

translations.literal: Gao Huan once had Jinghe shoot a wild boar; with one arrow he took it. Gao Huan admired him deeply and made him straight commander of the storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan once had Jinghe shoot a wild boar; with one arrow he took it. Gao Huan admired him deeply and made him straight commander of the storehouse.

sentences.zh: 天保初，授假節、通州刺史，封永寧縣開國子。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was given acting credentials, made inspector of Tongzhou, and enfeoffed as Baron of Yongning county with a state.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao he was given acting credentials, made inspector of Tongzhou, and enfeoffed as baron of Yongning county with a state.

sentences.zh: 後從襲庫莫奚，加左右大都督。

translations.literal: Later he followed the raid on the Kumo Xi and was additionally made great commander of the left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed the raid on the Kumo Xi and was additionally made great commander of the left and right.

sentences.zh: 又從度黃龍，征契丹，定稽胡。

translations.literal: He again followed the crossing of Huanglong, the campaign against the Khitan, and the pacification of the Jiehu.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed the crossing of Huanglong, the campaign against the Khitan, and the pacification of the Jiehu.

sentences.zh: 尋從討茹茹主菴羅辰於陘北，又從平茹茹餘燼。

translations.literal: Soon he again followed the campaign against the Rouran ruler Anluochen north of the pass and again followed the pacification of the Rouran remnant embers.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he again followed the campaign against the Rouran ruler Anluochen north of the pass and again followed the pacification of the Rouran remnant embers.

sentences.zh: 景和趫捷，有武用，每有戰功。

translations.literal: Jinghe was nimble and had martial use; whenever there was military achievement it was his.
translations.idiomatic: Jinghe was nimble and had martial use; whenever there was achievement in battle it was his.

sentences.zh: 十年，食安樂郡幹。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he drew salary from the dry fief of Anle commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he drew salary from the dry fief of Anle commandery.

sentences.zh: 乾明元年，除武衛將軍，兼給事黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianming he was made general of the martial guard, concurrently gentleman attendant of the yellow gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Qianming year he was made general of the martial guard, concurrently gentleman attendant of the yellow gate.

sentences.zh: 肅宗作相，以本官攝大丞相府從事中郎。

translations.literal: When Gao Yan served as chief minister, in his original office he acted as staff deliberator in the great chancellor's government office.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Yan served as chief minister, in his original office he acted as staff deliberator in the great chancellor's government office.

sentences.zh: 大寧元年，除儀同三司、散騎常侍、武衛大將軍，尋加開府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daning he was made equal in rank to the Three Excellencies, scattered cavalry regular attendant, and great general of the martial guard; soon he was additionally made opener of the government.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Daning year he was made equal in rank to the three excellencies, scattered-cavalry regular attendant, and great general of the martial guard; soon he was additionally made opener of the government.

sentences.zh: 二年，出為梁州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year he went out as inspector of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he went out as inspector of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，突厥圍逼晉陽，令景和馳驛赴京，督領後軍赴幷州，未到間，賊已退。

translations.literal: In the third year the Turks pressed and besieged Jinyang; Jinghe was ordered to ride post-horses to the capital, supervise and lead the rear army to Bingzhou, but before he arrived the bandits had already withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Turks pressed and besieged Jinyang. Jinghe was ordered to ride post-horses to the capital, supervise and lead the rear army to Bingzhou, but before he arrived the bandits had already withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 仍除領左右大將軍，食齊郡幹，又除幷省五兵尚書。

translations.literal: He was then made great general who leads the left and right, drew salary from the dry fief of Qi commandery, and was again made director of the five armies in the metropolitan office.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made great general who leads the left and right, drew salary from the dry fief of Qi commandery, and was again made director of the five armies in the metropolitan office.

sentences.zh: 天統元年，遷殿中尚書。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiantong he was moved to director of the palace department.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Tiantong year he was moved to director of the palace department.

sentences.zh: 二年，除侍中。

translations.literal: In the second year he was made attendant-in-ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 景和於武職之中，兼長吏事，又性識均平，故頻有美授。

translations.literal: Among military offices Jinghe also excelled at civil affairs, and his nature and judgment were even and fair; therefore he repeatedly received fine appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Among military offices Jinghe also excelled at civil affairs, and his nature and judgment were even and fair; therefore he repeatedly received fine appointments.

sentences.zh: 周通好之後，冠蓋往來，常令景和對接，每與使人同射，百發百中，甚見推重。

translations.literal: After peace was made with Zhou, envoys came and went; Jinghe was constantly ordered to receive them. Whenever he shot together with the envoys, a hundred shots brought a hundred hits, and he was greatly esteemed.
translations.idiomatic: After peace was made with Zhou, envoys came and went, and Jinghe was constantly ordered to receive them. Whenever he shot together with the envoys, a hundred shots brought a hundred hits, and he was greatly esteemed.

sentences.zh: 武平中，詔獄多令中黃門等監治，恒令景和按覆，據理執正，由是過無枉濫。

translations.literal: In the Wuping era the imperial prison often had inner yellow gate men and others supervise cases; Jinghe was constantly ordered to review and verify them. Holding to reason and acting upright, thereby no case was wrongly excessive.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wuping era the imperial prison often had inner yellow-gate men and others supervise cases; Jinghe was constantly ordered to review and verify them. Holding to reason and acting upright, thereby no case was wrongly excessive.

sentences.zh: 後除特進、中領軍，封廣漢郡開國公。

translations.literal: Later he was made specially advanced and central commander of the guards, enfeoffed as Duke of Guanghan commandery with a state.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was made specially advanced and central commander of the guards, enfeoffed as duke of Guanghan commandery with a state.

sentences.zh: 又隨斛律光率衆西討，剋姚襄、白亭二城，別封永寧郡開國公。

translations.literal: He again followed Hulu Guang in leading troops on a western campaign and took the two cities of Yaoxiang and Baiting; he was separately enfeoffed as Duke of Yongning commandery with a state.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Hulu Guang in leading troops on a western campaign and took the two cities of Yaoxiang and Baiting; he was separately enfeoffed as duke of Yongning commandery with a state.

sentences.zh: 又除領軍將軍。

translations.literal: He was again made general who commands the army.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made general who commands the army.

sentences.zh: 又從軍拔宜陽城，封開封郡開國公。

translations.literal: He again followed the army in taking Yiyang city and was enfeoffed as Duke of Kaifeng commandery with a state.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed the army in taking Yiyang city and was enfeoffed as duke of Kaifeng commandery with a state.

sentences.zh: 瑯邪王之殺和士開也，兵指西闕，內外惶惑，莫知所為。

translations.literal: When Prince of Langye killed He Shikai, troops pointed at the western gate-tower; inside and outside were fearful and none knew what to do.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince of Langye killed He Shikai, troops pointed at the western gate-tower; inside and outside were fearful and none knew what to do.

sentences.zh: 景和請後主出千秋門自號令。

translations.literal: Jinghe asked the Later Sovereign to go out through the Qianqiu Gate and issue commands himself.
translations.idiomatic: Jinghe asked the Later Sovereign to go out through the Qianqiu Gate and issue commands himself.

sentences.zh: 事平，除尚書右僕射、趙州刺史。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled he was made right vice director of the masters of writing and inspector of Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled he was made right vice director of the masters of writing and inspector of Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 尋遷河南行臺尚書右僕射、洛州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was moved to right vice director of the masters of writing on the Henan mobile staff and inspector of Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was moved to right vice director of the masters of writing on the Henan mobile staff and inspector of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 陳將吳明徹寇淮南，令景和率衆拒之，除領軍大將軍，封文城郡王，轉食高陽郡幹。

translations.literal: Liang general Wu Mingche invaded Huainan; Jinghe was ordered to lead troops to resist him. He was made great general who commands the army, enfeoffed as Prince of Wencheng commandery, and transferred his salary to the dry fief of Gaoyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Liang general Wu Mingche invaded Huainan; Jinghe was ordered to lead troops to resist him. He was made great general who commands the army, enfeoffed as prince of Wencheng commandery, and transferred his salary to the dry fief of Gaoyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 軍至柤口，值土人陳喧等作亂，景和平之。

translations.literal: When the army reached Zhakou, local men Chen Xuan and others rose in disorder; Jinghe pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Zhakou, local men Chen Xuan and others rose in disorder; Jinghe pacified them.

sentences.zh: 又有陽平人鄭子饒，詐依佛道，設齋會，用米面不多，供贍甚廣，密從地藏漸出餅飯，愚人以為神力，見信於魏、衛之間。

translations.literal: There was also Yangping man Zheng Zirao, who falsely relied on the Buddha Way, set up vegetarian feasts, used little rice and flour yet supplied provisions very broadly, and secretly from underground gradually produced cakes and rice—fools took it for divine power, and he was believed between Wei and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Yangping man Zheng Zirao, who falsely relied on the Buddha Way, set up vegetarian feasts, used little rice and flour yet supplied provisions very broadly, and secretly from underground gradually produced cakes and rice. Fools took it for divine power, and he won belief between Wei and Wei.

sentences.zh: 將為逆亂，謀泄，掩討漏逸。

translations.literal: He was about to make rebellion; the plot leaked and he was seized in a surprise attack, but escaped through a gap.
translations.idiomatic: He was about to rebel; the plot leaked and he was seized in a surprise attack, but escaped through a gap.

sentences.zh: 乃潛渡河，聚衆數千，自號長樂王，已破乘氏縣，又欲襲西兗州城。

translations.literal: He then secretly crossed the river, gathered several thousand men, styled himself Prince of Changle, had already taken Chengyi county, and again intended to raid the city of Western Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then secretly crossed the river, gathered several thousand men, styled himself prince of Changle, had already taken Chengyi county, and again intended to raid the city of Western Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 景和自南兗州遣騎數百擊破之，斬首二千餘級，生擒子饒，送京師烹之。

translations.literal: Jinghe sent several hundred horsemen from Southern Yanzhou and defeated them, beheading more than two thousand, capturing Zirao alive, and sending him to the capital to be boiled.
translations.idiomatic: Jinghe sent several hundred horsemen from Southern Yanzhou and defeated them, beheading more than two thousand, capturing Zirao alive, and sending him to the capital to be boiled.

sentences.zh: 及吳明徹圍壽陽，勑令景和與賀拔伏恩等赴救。

translations.literal: When Wu Mingche besieged Shouyang, an edict ordered Jinghe to go with Heba Fu'en and others to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Mingche besieged Shouyang, an edict ordered Jinghe to go with Heba Fu'en and others to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 景和以尉破胡軍始喪敗，怯懦不敢進，頓兵淮口，頻有勑使催捉，然始渡淮。

translations.literal: Jinghe, because the army of Wei Pohu had first suffered defeat, was timid and did not dare advance; he halted the army at Huaikou. Edict envoys repeatedly came to urge him on, yet only then did he cross the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Jinghe, because the army of Wei Pohu had first suffered defeat, was timid and did not dare advance; he halted the army at Huaikou. Edict envoys repeatedly came to urge him on, yet only then did he cross the Huai.

sentences.zh: 屬壽陽已陷，狼狽北還，器械軍資，大致遺失。

translations.literal: It happened that Shouyang had already fallen; he fled north in disorder, and weapons and military stores were for the most part lost.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Shouyang had already fallen; he fled north in disorder, and weapons and military stores were for the most part lost.

sentences.zh: 陳將蕭摩訶率步騎於淮北倉陵城截之，景和得整旅逆戰，摩訶退歸。

translations.literal: Liang general Xiao Mohe led infantry and cavalry and intercepted him at Cangling city north of the Huai; Jinghe got his troops in order and fought him in reverse; Mohe withdrew and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Liang general Xiao Mohe led infantry and cavalry and intercepted him at Cangling city north of the Huai. Jinghe got his troops in order and fought him in reverse; Mohe withdrew and returned.

sentences.zh: 是時拒吳明徹者多致傾覆，唯景和全軍而還，由是獲賞，除尚書令，別封西河郡開國公，賜錢二十萬，酒米十車。

translations.literal: At the time many who resisted Wu Mingche met ruin; only Jinghe returned with the whole army intact, and thereby he received reward: he was made director of the masters of writing, separately enfeoffed as Duke of Xihe commandery with a state, and given two hundred thousand in cash plus ten cartloads of wine and rice.
translations.idiomatic: At the time many who resisted Wu Mingche met ruin; only Jinghe returned with the whole army intact, and thereby he received reward. He was made director of the masters of writing, separately enfeoffed as duke of Xihe commandery with a state, and given two hundred thousand in cash plus ten cartloads of wine and rice.

sentences.zh: 時陳人聲將渡淮，令景和停軍西兗州，為拒守節度。

translations.literal: At the time Liang voices said they would cross the Huai; Jinghe was ordered to halt the army in Western Yanzhou as commander for defense and resistance.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Liang voices said they would cross the Huai; Jinghe was ordered to halt the army in Western Yanzhou as commander for defense and resistance.

sentences.zh: 武平六年病卒，年五十五。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Wuping he died of illness, aged fifty-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth Wuping year he died of illness, aged fifty-five.

sentences.zh: 贈侍中、使持節、都督定恒朔幽定平六州諸軍事、太尉公、錄尚書事、定州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was given attendant-in-ordinary, bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of the six provinces Ding, Heng, Shuo, You, Ding, and Ping, Duke of the Grand Commandant, recorder of the masters of writing affairs, and inspector of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was given attendant-in-ordinary, bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of the six provinces Ding, Heng, Shuo, You, Ding, and Ping, duke of the grand commandant, recorder of the masters of writing affairs, and inspector of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 長子信，機悟有風神，微涉書傳。

translations.literal: His eldest son Xin was quick-witted and had bearing; he lightly dipped into books and records.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Xin was quick-witted and had bearing; he lightly dipped into books and records.

sentences.zh: 武平末，開府儀同三司、武衛將軍，於勳貴子弟之中，稱其識鑒。

translations.literal: Late in Wuping he was opener of the government with rank equal to the Three Excellencies and general of the martial guard; among sons of meritorious nobles he was praised for discernment.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Wuping he was opener of the government with rank equal to the three excellencies and general of the martial guard; among sons of meritorious nobles he was praised for discernment.

sentences.zh: 於幷州降周軍，授上開府、軍正大夫。

translations.literal: At Bingzhou he surrendered to the Zhou army and was appointed supreme opener of the government and rectifier of the army.
translations.idiomatic: At Bingzhou he surrendered to the Zhou army and was appointed supreme opener of the government and rectifier of the army.

sentences.zh: 隋開皇中，卒於洮州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he died as inspector of Taozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he died as inspector of Taozhou.

sentences.zh: 少子宿達，武平末太子齋帥，有才藻檢行。

translations.literal: His younger son Sudda, late in Wuping, was director of fasts for the heir apparent; he had literary talent and restrained conduct.
translations.idiomatic: His younger son Sudda, late in Wuping, was director of fasts for the heir apparent; he had literary talent and restrained conduct.

sentences.zh: 開皇中，通事舍人。

translations.literal: In the Kaihuang era he was communications attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaihuang era he was communications attendant.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，起復，將赴京，辭靈慟哭而絕，久而獲蘇，不能下食，三日致死。

translations.literal: When his mother's mourning ended he was recalled to service; about to go to the capital, he took leave of the spirit tablet, wailed in grief, and stopped breathing; long after he revived but could not take food, and on the third day he died.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother's mourning ended he was recalled to service. About to go to the capital, he took leave of the spirit tablet, wailed in grief, and stopped breathing. Long after he revived but could not take food, and on the third day he died.

sentences.zh: 鮮于世榮，漁陽人也。

translations.literal: Xianyu Shirong was a man of Yuyang.
translations.idiomatic: Xianyu Shirong came from Yuyang.

sentences.zh: 父寶業，懷朔鎮將，武平初，贈儀同三司、祠部尚書、朔州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Baoye was garrison commander of Huaishuo; early in Wuping he was posthumously given equal rank to the Three Excellencies, director of the ministry of sacrifices, and inspector of Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Baoye was garrison commander of Huaishuo; early in Wuping he was posthumously given equal rank to the three excellencies, director of the ministry of sacrifices, and inspector of Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 世榮少而沈敏，有器幹。

translations.literal: Shirong from youth was deep and keen and had capacity and backbone.
translations.idiomatic: Shirong from youth was deep and keen and had capacity and backbone.

sentences.zh: 興和二年，為高祖親信副都督，稍遷平西將軍、賜爵石門縣子。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xinghe he was Gao Huan's deputy commander of trusted intimates; he was gradually promoted to general who pacifies the west and ennobled as Baron of Shimen county.
translations.idiomatic: In the second Xinghe year he was Gao Huan's deputy commander of trusted intimates; he was gradually promoted to general who pacifies the west and ennobled as baron of Shimen county.

sentences.zh: 後頻從顯祖討茹茹，破稽胡。

translations.literal: Later he repeatedly followed Gao Yang in campaigning against the Rouran and defeating the Jiehu.
translations.idiomatic: Later he repeatedly followed Gao Yang in campaigning against the Rouran and defeating the Jiehu.

sentences.zh: 又從高岳平郢州，除持節、河州刺史，食朝歌縣幹。

translations.literal: He again followed Gao Yue in pacifying Yingzhou and was made bearer of the staff of authority and inspector of Hezhou, drawing salary from the dry fief of Chaoge county.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Gao Yue in pacifying Yingzhou and was made bearer of the staff of authority and inspector of Hezhou, drawing salary from the dry fief of Chaoge county.

sentences.zh: 尋為肅宗丞相府諮議參軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was made deliberator of staff affairs in Gao Yan's chancellor government office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made deliberator of staff affairs in Gao Yan's chancellor government office.

sentences.zh: 皇建中，除儀同三司、武衛將軍。

translations.literal: In Huangjian he was made gentleman of the same third rank and general of the martial guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangjian he was made gentleman of the same third rank and general of the martial guard.

sentences.zh: 天統二年，加開府，又除鄭州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiantong he was given an open office, and was also made governor of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tiantong he received an open office and was also made governor of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 武平中，以平信州賊，除領軍將軍，轉食上黨郡幹。

translations.literal: In Wuping, for pacifying the bandits of Xin province, he was made director of the guard corps and transferred to fief income of Shangdang commandery dry.
translations.idiomatic: In Wuping, for pacifying the Xin province rebels, he was made director of the guard corps and given fief income from Shangdang commandery dry.

sentences.zh: 從平高思好，封義陽王。

translations.literal: He followed in the pacification of Gao Sihao and was enfeoffed Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the campaign against Gao Sihao and was enfeoffed Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 七年，後主幸晉陽，令世榮以本官判尚書右僕射事，貳北平王北宮留後。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Later Sovereign visited Jinyang and ordered Shirong, in his existing office, to act as right vice director of the masters of writing and second the Prince of Beiping as northern-palace rearward officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Later Sovereign visited Jinyang and ordered Shirong, retaining his existing rank, to act as right vice director of the masters of writing while seconding the Prince of Beiping as rearward officer of the northern palace.

sentences.zh: 尋有勑令與吏部尚書袁聿修在尚書省檢試舉人。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered him and Minister of Personnel Yuan Yuxiu to examine candidates for office within the masters of writing.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered him and Minister of Personnel Yuan Yuxiu to examine office candidates in the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 為乘馬至雲龍門外入省北門，為憲司舉奏免官。

translations.literal: He rode a horse to outside the Cloud Dragon Gate and entered the northern gate of the ministry; the censorate impeached him and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He rode his horse to outside the Cloud Dragon Gate and entered the ministry's north gate; the censorate impeached him and he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 後主圍平陽，除世榮領軍將軍。

translations.literal: When the Later Sovereign besieged Pingyang, Shirong was made director of the guard corps.
translations.idiomatic: When the Later Sovereign besieged Pingyang, Shirong was made director of the guard corps.

sentences.zh: 周師將入鄴，除領軍大將軍、太子太傅，於城西拒戰，敗被擒，為周武所殺。

translations.literal: As Zhou troops were about to enter Ye, he was made grand general of the guard corps and grand tutor of the heir apparent; he fought them off west of the city, was defeated and captured, and was killed by Zhou Wu.
translations.idiomatic: As Zhou troops were about to enter Ye, he was made grand general of the guard corps and grand tutor of the heir apparent. He fought west of the city, was defeated and captured, and Zhou Wu had him killed.

sentences.zh: 世榮雖武人無文藝，以朝危政亂，每竊嘆之。

translations.literal: Though Shirong was a fighting man without literary arts, with the court endangered and government in disorder he would sigh to himself.
translations.idiomatic: Though Shirong was a fighting man without literary polish, with the court endangered and government in disorder he would sigh to himself.

sentences.zh: 見徵稅無厭，賜與過度，發言嘆惜。

translations.literal: Seeing levies without end and gifts beyond measure, he spoke out in lament.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing levies without end and gifts beyond measure, he spoke out in lament.

sentences.zh: 子子貞，武平末假儀同三司。

translations.literal: His son Zizhen, at the end of Wuping, held acting gentleman of the same third rank.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zizhen, at the end of Wuping, held acting gentleman of the same third rank.

sentences.zh: 綦連猛，字武兒，代人也。

translations.literal: Qilian Meng, styled Wuer, was a man of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Qilian Meng, styled Wuer, came from Dai.

sentences.zh: 其先姬姓，六國末，避亂出塞，保祁連山，因以山為姓，北人語訛，故曰綦連氏。

translations.literal: His ancestors were of the Ji clan; at the end of the Six States they fled the turmoil beyond the frontier, took refuge on Mount Qilian, and took the mountain as surname; northern speech slurred it, hence the clan name Qilian.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors were of the Ji clan. At the end of the Six States they fled turmoil beyond the frontier, took refuge on Mount Qilian, and took the mountain as surname; northern speech slurred it, hence the clan name Qilian.

sentences.zh: 父元成，燕郡太守。

translations.literal: His father Yuancheng was administrator of Yan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yuancheng was administrator of Yan commandery.

sentences.zh: 步落稽等起逆，在覆釜山，使猛討之，大捷，特被賞賫。

translations.literal: When Buluoji and others rose in revolt on Mount Fufu, Meng was sent to suppress them; he won a great victory and received special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: When Buluoji and others rose in revolt on Mount Fufu, Meng was sent to suppress them, won a great victory, and received special rewards.

sentences.zh: 元象元年，從高祖向河陽，與周文帝戰於邙山。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang he followed Gao Huan toward Heyang and fought the Zhou founder Wen on Mount Mang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanxiang he followed Gao Huan toward Heyang and fought the Zhou founder Wen on Mount Mang.

sentences.zh: 二年，除平東將軍、中散大夫。

translations.literal: In the second year he was made general who pacifies the east and grand master of palace attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made general who pacifies the east and grand master of palace attendance.

sentences.zh: 其年，又轉中外府帳內都督，賞邙山之功，封廣興縣開國君。

translations.literal: That year he was again transferred to inner and outer office staff commander; for merit at Mount Mang he was enfeoffed Marquis Who Opens the State of Guangxing.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was again made inner and outer office staff commander; for merit at Mount Mang he was enfeoffed Marquis Who Opens the State of Guangxing.

sentences.zh: 五年，梁使來聘，雲有武藝，求訪北人，欲與相角。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Liang envoys came on a mission; they said they had martial skill and wished to seek out northerners to test against.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Liang envoys came on a mission. They boasted of martial skill and wished to find northerners to test against.

sentences.zh: 世宗遣猛就館接之，雙帶兩鞬，左右馳射。

translations.literal: The heir apparent Gao Cheng sent Meng to the guest lodge to receive them; he wore two quivers at his belt and galloped left and right shooting.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Cheng sent Meng to the guest lodge to receive them. Meng wore two quivers at his belt and galloped left and right while shooting.

sentences.zh: 兼共試力，挽強，梁人引弓兩張，力皆三石，猛遂並取四張，疊而挽之，過度。

translations.literal: They also tested strength together in drawing the bow; the Liang men drew two bows, each at three piculs' draw; Meng then took four at once, stacked them, and drew them past the mark.
translations.idiomatic: They also tested strength at the bow. The Liang men drew two bows, each at three piculs' draw. Meng took four at once, stacked them, and drew them past the mark.

sentences.zh: 梁人嗟服之。

translations.literal: The Liang men sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang envoys sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 其年，除撫軍將軍，別封石城縣開國子，食肆州平寇縣幹。

translations.literal: That year he was made general who pacifies the army; separately he was enfeoffed Viscount Who Opens the State of Shicheng, with fief income of Pingkou county dry in Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was made general who pacifies the army and separately enfeoffed Viscount Who Opens the State of Shicheng, with fief income from Pingkou county dry in Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 天保元年，除都督、東秦州刺史，別封雍州京兆郡覆城縣開國男。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianbao he was made commander and governor of eastern Qin; separately he was enfeoffed Baron Who Opens the State of Fucheng in Jingzhao commandery of Yong province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianbao he was made commander and governor of eastern Qin and separately enfeoffed Baron Who Opens the State of Fucheng in Jingzhao commandery of Yong province.

sentences.zh: 從顯祖討契丹，大獲戶口。

translations.literal: He followed Gao Yang in the campaign against the Khitan and took a great haul of households.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Gao Yang against the Khitan and took a great haul of households.

sentences.zh: 又隨斛律敦北征茹茹，敦令猛輕將百騎深入覘候。

translations.literal: He also followed Hulu Lüdun on the northern expedition against the Ruru; Lüdun ordered Meng with a light detachment of a hundred horsemen to penetrate deep on reconnaissance.
translations.idiomatic: He also followed Hulu Lüdun on the northern expedition against the Ruru. Lüdun ordered Meng with a light detachment of a hundred horsemen to probe deep on reconnaissance.

sentences.zh: 還至白道，與軍相會，因此追躡，遂大破之。

translations.literal: Returning to White Pass, he joined the main army and thereby pursued; he broke them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to White Pass he joined the main army, pursued, and broke them utterly.

sentences.zh: 賚帛三百段。

translations.literal: He was given three hundred bolts of silk as reward.
translations.idiomatic: He was rewarded with three hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 七年，除武衛將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was made general of the martial guard and gentleman of the same third rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made general of the martial guard and gentleman of the same third rank.

sentences.zh: 九年，轉武衛大將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to grand general of the martial guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to grand general of the martial guard.

sentences.zh: 乾明初，加車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: Early in Qianming he was given grand general of the cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianming he was given grand general of the cavalry.

sentences.zh: 皇建元年，封石城郡開國伯，尋進爵為君。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangjian he was enfeoffed Earl Who Opens the State of Shicheng commandery; soon his rank rose to marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangjian he was enfeoffed Earl Who Opens the State of Shicheng commandery; soon his rank rose to marquis.

sentences.zh: 二年，除領左右大將軍，從肅宗討奚賊，大捷，獲馬二千匹，牛羊三萬頭。

translations.literal: In the second year he was made grand general of the left and right guard; he followed Gao Yan in suppressing Xi bandits, won a great victory, and took two thousand horses and thirty thousand head of cattle and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made grand general of the left and right guard. He followed Gao Yan against Xi bandits, won a great victory, and took two thousand horses and thirty thousand head of cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 河清二年，加開府。

translations.literal: In the second year of Heqing he was given an open office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Heqing he received an open office.

sentences.zh: 突厥侵逼晉陽，勑猛將三百騎覘賊遠近。

translations.literal: When the Turks pressed on Jinyang, an edict ordered Meng with three hundred horsemen to scout the enemy's distance.
translations.idiomatic: When the Turks pressed on Jinyang, an edict ordered Meng with three hundred horsemen to scout how far the enemy had come.

sentences.zh: 行至城北十五里，遇賊前鋒，以敵衆多，遂漸退避。

translations.literal: He reached fifteen li north of the city, met the enemy vanguard, and because their numbers were many gradually drew back.
translations.idiomatic: He reached fifteen li north of the city, met the enemy vanguard, and because their numbers were great gradually drew back.

sentences.zh: 賊中有一驍將，超出來鬥。

translations.literal: Among the enemy was one fierce general who came out beyond the line to fight.
translations.idiomatic: Among the enemy was one fierce general who rode out beyond the line to fight.

sentences.zh: 猛遙見之，即亦挺身獨出，與其相對。

translations.literal: Meng saw him from afar and at once also thrust himself out alone to face him.
translations.idiomatic: Meng saw him from afar and at once thrust himself out alone to face him.

sentences.zh: 俯仰之間，刺賊落馬，因即斬之。

translations.literal: In the space of a bow's motion he stabbed the enemy off his horse and at once beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the space of a bow's motion he stabbed the enemy off his horse and at once beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 三年，別封武安縣開國君，加驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In the third year he was separately enfeoffed Marquis Who Opens the State of Wu'an county and given grand general of the fleet cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was separately enfeoffed Marquis Who Opens the State of Wu'an county and made grand general of the fleet cavalry.

sentences.zh: 天統元年，遷右衛大將軍，乃奉世祖勑，恒令在嗣主左右，兼知內外機要之事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiantong he was transferred to grand general of the right guard; he then received Gao Zhan's edict to remain constantly at the heir apparent's side and also to know inner and outer confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tiantong he was transferred to grand general of the right guard and received Gao Zhan's edict to remain constantly at the heir apparent's side while also knowing inner and outer confidential affairs.

sentences.zh: 三年，除中領軍。

translations.literal: In the third year he was made central director of the guard corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made central director of the guard corps.

sentences.zh: 四年，轉領軍將軍，別封義寧縣開國君。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to director of the guard corps and separately enfeoffed Marquis Who Opens the State of Yining county.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was transferred to director of the guard corps and separately enfeoffed Marquis Who Opens the State of Yining county.

sentences.zh: 五年，除幷省尚書左僕射，餘如故。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was made left vice director of the masters of writing of the joint provinces, the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made left vice director of the masters of writing of the joint provinces; the rest of his offices remained as before.

sentences.zh: 除幷省尚書令、領軍大將軍，封山陽王。

translations.literal: He was made chief minister of the masters of writing of the joint provinces and grand general of the guard corps, and enfeoffed Prince of Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: He was made chief minister of the masters of writing of the joint provinces and grand general of the guard corps, and enfeoffed Prince of Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 猛自和士開死後，漸預朝政，疑議與奪，咸亦咨稟。

translations.literal: After He Shikai's death Meng gradually took part in court government; on doubtful matters of judgment and appointment all consulted and reported to him.
translations.idiomatic: After He Shikai's death Meng gradually took part in court government; on doubtful matters of judgment and appointment all consulted and reported to him.

sentences.zh: 趙彥深以猛武將之中頗疾姦佞，言議時有可采，故引知機事。

translations.literal: Zhao Yanshen, because among fighting generals Meng especially hated treachery and flattery and his counsel was sometimes worth taking, drew him into knowing confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanshen, because among fighting generals Meng especially hated treachery and flattery and his counsel was sometimes worth taking, drew him into confidential affairs.

sentences.zh: 祖珽既出彥深，以猛為趙之黨與，乃除光州刺史。

translations.literal: After Zu Ting had removed Yanshen, he treated Meng as Zhao's partisan and therefore made him governor of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: After Zu Ting had removed Yanshen, he treated Meng as Zhao's partisan and therefore made him governor of Guang.

sentences.zh: 已發至牛蘭，忽有人告和士開被害日猛亦知情，遂被追止。

translations.literal: He had already set out and reached Niulan when suddenly someone reported that on the day He Shikai was killed Meng had also known of it; he was pursued and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He had already set out and reached Niulan when suddenly someone reported that on the day He Shikai was killed Meng had also known of it; he was pursued and stopped.

sentences.zh: 還，入內禁留，簿錄家口。

translations.literal: He returned, was detained inside the palace, and his household was inventoried.
translations.idiomatic: He returned, was detained inside the palace, and his household was inventoried.

sentences.zh: 尋見釋，削王爵，止以開府赴州。

translations.literal: Soon he was released; his princely rank was stripped and he went to his province with only an open office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was released, his princely rank was stripped, and he went to his province with only an open office.

sentences.zh: 在任寬惠清慎，吏民稱之。

translations.literal: In office he was lenient, kind, and clear-minded; officials and people praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In office he was lenient, kind, and clear-minded; officials and people praised him.

sentences.zh: 淮陰王阿那肱與猛有舊，每欲攜引之，曾有勑徵詣闕，似欲委寄。

translations.literal: Prince Huaiyin Anaigong was old friends with Meng and always wished to draw him up; there was once an edict summoning him to court, as if to entrust him with office.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Huaiyin Anaigong was old friends with Meng and always wished to draw him up. Once an edict summoned him to court, as if to entrust him with office.

sentences.zh: 韓長鸞等沮難，復除膠州刺史。

translations.literal: Han Changluan and others obstructed it; he was again made governor of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: Han Changluan and others obstructed it; he was again made governor of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 尋徵還，令在南兗防捍。

translations.literal: Soon he was recalled and ordered to defend southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was recalled and ordered to defend southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 後主平陽敗還，又徵赴鄴，除大將軍。

translations.literal: When the Later Sovereign returned defeated from Pingyang he was again summoned to Ye and made grand general.
translations.idiomatic: When the Later Sovereign returned defeated from Pingyang he was again summoned to Ye and made grand general.

sentences.zh: 齊亡入周，尋卒。

translations.literal: When Qi fell he entered Zhou; he died soon after.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi fell he entered Zhou and died soon after.

sentences.zh: 元景安，魏昭成五世孫也。

translations.literal: Yuan Jing'an was a fifth-generation descendant of Emperor Zhaocheng of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Jing'an was a fifth-generation descendant of Emperor Zhaocheng of Wei.

sentences.zh: 高祖虔，魏陳留王。

translations.literal: His ancestor Gao Qian was Prince of Chenliu of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestor Gao Qian was Prince of Chenliu of Wei.

sentences.zh: 父永，少為奉朝請。

translations.literal: His father Yong, in youth, was a court attendant.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yong had been a court attendant in youth.

sentences.zh: 自積射將軍為元天穆薦之於尒朱榮，參立孝莊之謀，賜爵代郡公。

translations.literal: From repeated-shot general he was recommended by Yuan Tianmu to Erzhu Rong; he took part in the plot to establish Emperor Xiaozhuang and was given the title Duke of Dai commandery.
translations.idiomatic: From repeated-shot general he was recommended by Yuan Tianmu to Erzhu Rong, took part in the plot to establish Emperor Xiaozhuang, and was given the title Duke of Dai commandery.

sentences.zh: 加將軍、太中大夫、二夏、幽三州行臺左丞，持節招納降戶四千餘家。

translations.literal: He was further made general, grand master of palace attendance, left aide of the mobile office for the second summer and You and three provinces, and with staff of authority received and settled more than four thousand surrendered households.
translations.idiomatic: He was further made general and grand master of palace attendance, left aide of the mobile office for the second summer and You and three provinces, and with staff of authority received and settled more than four thousand surrendered households.

sentences.zh: 榮又啟封永朝那縣子，邑三百戶，持節南幽州刺史，假撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: Rong also memorialized to enfeoff Yong as Viscount of Chaona county, fief three hundred households, with staff of authority as governor of southern You and acting general who pacifies the army.
translations.idiomatic: Rong also memorialized to enfeoff Yong as Viscount of Chaona county with a fief of three hundred households, and to give him staff of authority as governor of southern You and acting general who pacifies the army.

sentences.zh: 天平初，高祖以為行臺左丞，尋除潁州刺史，又為北揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Early in Tianping Gao Huan made him left aide of the mobile office; soon he was made governor of Ying, then again governor of northern Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tianping Gao Huan made him left aide of the mobile office; soon he was made governor of Ying, then again governor of northern Yang.

sentences.zh: 天保中，征拜大司農卿，遷銀青光祿大夫，依例降爵為幹鄉男。

translations.literal: In Tianbao he was summoned as chief minister of the grand granary, transferred to silver-blue-luminous grandee, and by precedent his title was reduced to Baron of Ganxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao he was summoned as chief minister of the grand granary, transferred to silver-blue-luminous grandee, and by precedent his title was reduced to Baron of Ganxiang.

sentences.zh: 大寧二年，遷金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daning he was transferred to gold-purple-luminous grandee.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daning he was transferred to gold-purple-luminous grandee.

sentences.zh: 景安沈敏有幹局，少工騎射，善於事人。

translations.literal: Jing'an was deep, keen, and capable; from youth he was skilled at mounted archery and good at serving men.
translations.idiomatic: Jing'an was deep, keen, and capable; from youth he was skilled at mounted archery and good at winning men.

sentences.zh: 釋褐尒朱榮大將軍府長流參軍，加寧遠將軍，又轉榮大丞相府長流參軍。

translations.literal: On leaving the crimson he was long-flow aide in Erzhu Rong's grand general's office, given general who pacifies the distant; he was again transferred to long-flow aide in Rong's grand chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: On leaving the crimson he was long-flow aide in Erzhu Rong's grand general's office and made general who pacifies the distant; he was again transferred to long-flow aide in Rong's grand chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 高祖平洛陽，領軍婁昭薦補京畿都督，父永啟回代郡公授之，加前將軍、太中大夫。

translations.literal: When Gao Huan pacified Luoyang, Director of the Guard Corps Lou Zhao recommended him to fill the capital-area commandery; his father Yong memorialized to transfer the Duke of Dai commandery to him, and he was given front general and grand master of palace attendance.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan pacified Luoyang, Director of the Guard Corps Lou Zhao recommended him for the capital-area commandery. His father Yong memorialized to transfer the Duke of Dai commandery to him, and he was given front general and grand master of palace attendance.

sentences.zh: 隨武帝西入。

translations.literal: He followed Emperor Wu on the western entry.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Emperor Wu on the western entry.

sentences.zh: 天平末，大軍西討，景安臨陣自歸，高祖嘉之，即補都督。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianping the great army campaigned west; Jing'an surrendered on the field; Gao Huan was pleased and at once appointed him commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Tianping the great army campaigned west. Jing'an surrendered on the field; Gao Huan was pleased and at once appointed him commander.

sentences.zh: 興和中，轉領親信都督。

translations.literal: In Xinghe he was transferred to director of trusted attendants.
translations.idiomatic: In Xinghe he was transferred to director of trusted attendants.

sentences.zh: 邙山之役，力戰有功，賜爵西華縣都鄉男，代郡公如故。

translations.literal: In the battle of Mount Mang he fought fiercely with merit and was given the title Baron of the Capital District of Xihua county; the Duke of Dai commandery remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: At Mount Mang he fought fiercely with merit and was given Baron of the Capital District of Xihua county; the Duke of Dai commandery remained as before.

sentences.zh: 世宗入朝，景安隨從在鄴。

translations.literal: When Gao Cheng entered court, Jing'an followed him to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Cheng entered court, Jing'an followed him to Ye.

sentences.zh: 於時江南款附，朝貢相尋，景安妙閑馳騁，雅有容則，每梁使至，恒令與斛律光、皮景和等對客騎射，見者稱善。

translations.literal: At that time the south of the Yangzi submitted in good faith and tribute missions followed one another; Jing'an was skilled and practiced at galloping and riding, and by nature had bearing and measure; whenever Liang envoys came he was always ordered with Hulu Guang, Pi Jinghe, and others to receive the guests in mounted archery, and onlookers praised it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the south of the Yangzi submitted in good faith and tribute missions followed one another. Jing'an was skilled at galloping and riding and by nature had bearing and measure. Whenever Liang envoys came he was always ordered with Hulu Guang, Pi Jinghe, and others to receive them in mounted archery, and onlookers praised it.

sentences.zh: 世宗嗣事，啟減國封分錫將士，封石保縣開國子，邑三百戶，加安西將軍。

translations.literal: When Gao Cheng succeeded to affairs he memorialized to reduce his state fief and distribute it to officers and soldiers; Jing'an was enfeoffed Viscount Who Opens the State of Shibao, fief three hundred households, and given general who pacifies the west.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Cheng succeeded to affairs he memorialized to reduce his state fief and distribute it to officers and soldiers. Jing'an was enfeoffed Viscount Who Opens the State of Shibao with a fief of three hundred households and made general who pacifies the west.

sentences.zh: 又授通州刺史，加鎮西將軍，轉子為伯，增邑通前六百戶，餘如故。

translations.literal: He was also made governor of Tong and given general who guards the west; his son was made earl and the fief increased with the former to six hundred households; the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was also made governor of Tong and given general who guards the west; his son was made earl and the fief increased with the former to six hundred households; the rest remained as before.

sentences.zh: 天保初，加征西將軍，別封興勢縣開國伯，帶定襄縣令，賜姓高氏。

translations.literal: Early in Tianbao he was given general who campaigns the west; separately he was enfeoffed Earl Who Opens the State of Xingshi, held the magistracy of Dingxiang, and was granted the surname Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tianbao he was given general who campaigns the west, separately enfeoffed Earl Who Opens the State of Xingshi, made magistrate of Dingxiang, and granted the surname Gao.

sentences.zh: 三年，從破庫莫奚於代川，轉領左右大都督，餘官並如故。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed in the defeat of the Kumo Xi on the Dai River and was transferred to grand commander of the left and right guard; his other offices all remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed the defeat of the Kumo Xi on the Dai River and was transferred to grand commander of the left and right guard; his other offices all remained as before.

sentences.zh: 四年，從討契丹於黃龍，領北平太守。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed the campaign against the Khitan at Yellow Dragon and held acting administrator of northern Ping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he followed the campaign against the Khitan at Yellow Dragon and held acting administrator of northern Ping.

sentences.zh: 後頻從駕再破茹茹，遷武衛大將軍，又轉領左右大將軍，兼七兵尚書。

translations.literal: Later he repeatedly followed the imperial carriage in again defeating the Ruru; he was transferred to grand general of the martial guard, then again to grand general of the left and right guard, and concurrently minister of the seven armories.
translations.idiomatic: Later he repeatedly followed the imperial carriage in again defeating the Ruru. He was transferred to grand general of the martial guard, then again to grand general of the left and right guard, and concurrently minister of the seven armories.

sentences.zh: 時初築長城，鎮戍未立，突厥強盛，慮或侵邊，仍詔景安與諸軍緣塞以備守。

translations.literal: At that time the long wall was first being built and frontier garrisons were not yet established; the Turks were strong and there was fear they might invade the border; an edict still ordered Jing'an with the various armies to patrol the frontier for defense.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the long wall was first being built and frontier garrisons were not yet established. The Turks were strong and there was fear they might invade the border, so an edict ordered Jing'an with the various armies to patrol the frontier for defense.

sentences.zh: 督領既多，且所部軍人富於財物，遂賄貨公行。

translations.literal: Because the command was broad and his troops were rich in goods, bribery soon ran openly.
translations.idiomatic: Because the command was broad and his troops were rich in goods, bribery soon ran openly.

sentences.zh: 顯祖聞之，遣使推檢，同行諸人贓汙狼藉，唯景安纖毫無犯。

translations.literal: Gao Yang heard of it and sent envoys to investigate; the colleagues on the mission were filthy with graft, but Jing'an had not the slightest offense.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yang heard of it and sent envoys to investigate. The colleagues on the mission were filthy with graft, but Jing'an had not the slightest offense.

sentences.zh: 帝深嘉嘆，乃詔有司以所聚斂贓絹伍百疋賜之，以彰清節。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply admired and sighed over this and therefore ordered the relevant office to give him five hundred bolts of the silk gathered as graft, to display his clean conduct.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply admired this and therefore ordered the relevant office to give him five hundred bolts of the silk gathered as graft, to display his clean conduct.

sentences.zh: 又轉都官尚書，加儀同三司，食高平郡幹，又拜儀同三司。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to minister of the ministry of justice, given gentleman of the same third rank and fief income of Gaoping commandery dry, and again made gentleman of the same third rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to minister of the ministry of justice, given gentleman of the same third rank and fief income from Gaoping commandery dry, and again made gentleman of the same third rank.

sentences.zh: 乾明元年，轉七兵尚書，加車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianming he was transferred to minister of the seven armories and given grand general of the cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianming he was transferred to minister of the seven armories and given grand general of the cavalry.

sentences.zh: 皇建元年，又兼侍中，馳驛詣鄴，慰勞百司，巡省風俗。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangjian he was also made attendant within the palace, sent by post horse to Ye to comfort and reward the hundred offices and inspect local customs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangjian he was also made attendant within the palace, sent by post horse to Ye to comfort and reward the hundred offices and inspect local customs.

sentences.zh: 肅宗曾與群臣於西園宴射，文武預者二百餘人。

translations.literal: Gao Yan once feasted and shot with the ministers in the western garden; more than two hundred civil and military men took part.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yan once feasted and shot with the ministers in the western garden; more than two hundred civil and military men took part.

sentences.zh: 設侯去堂百四十餘步，中的者賜與良馬及金玉錦彩等。

translations.literal: The target was set more than a hundred forty paces from the hall; those who hit the mark were given fine horses and gold, jade, brocade, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The target was set more than a hundred forty paces from the hall; those who hit the mark were given fine horses and gold, jade, brocade, and the like.

sentences.zh: 有一人射中獸頭，去鼻寸餘。

translations.literal: One man shot the beast's head, missing the nose by only a little more than an inch.
translations.idiomatic: One man shot the beast's head, missing the nose by only a little more than an inch.

sentences.zh: 唯景安最後有一矢未發，帝令景安解之，景安徐整容儀，操弓引滿，正中獸鼻。

translations.literal: Only Jing'an still had one arrow unshot; the emperor ordered Jing'an to loose it; Jing'an slowly composed his bearing, drew the bow full, and struck the beast's nose squarely.
translations.idiomatic: Only Jing'an still had one arrow unshot. The emperor ordered him to loose it. Jing'an slowly composed his bearing, drew the bow full, and struck the beast's nose squarely.

sentences.zh: 帝嗟賞稱善，特賚馬兩匹，玉帛雜物又加常等。

translations.literal: The emperor sighed in admiration and praised it; he was specially given two horses, and jade and silks beyond the usual measure.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sighed in admiration and praised it; he was specially given two horses, and jade and silks beyond the usual measure.

sentences.zh: 初，永兄祚襲爵陳留王，祚卒，子景皓嗣。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yong's elder brother Zuo had inherited the title Prince of Chenliu; when Zuo died his son Jinghao succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yong's elder brother Zuo had inherited the title Prince of Chenliu; when Zuo died his son Jinghao succeeded.

sentences.zh: 天保時，諸元帝室親近者多被誅戮。

translations.literal: In Tianbao many of the Yuan imperial house who were near kin were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao many of the Yuan imperial house who were near kin were put to death.

sentences.zh: 疏宗如景安之徒議欲請姓高氏，景皓云：「豈得棄本宗，逐他姓，大丈夫寧可玉碎，不能瓦全！

translations.literal: Distant clansmen such as Jing'an discussed asking for the surname Gao; Jinghao said: "How can one abandon one's own clan and follow another surname? A great man would rather be jade shattered than tile whole!
translations.idiomatic: Distant clansmen such as Jing'an discussed asking for the surname Gao. Jinghao said, "How can one abandon one's own clan and follow another surname? A great man would rather be jade shattered than tile whole!

sentences.zh: 」景安遂以此言白顯祖，乃收景皓誅之，家屬徙彭城。

translations.literal: " Jing'an then reported these words to Gao Yang; Jinghao was therefore seized and executed, and his household was moved to Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing'an then reported these words to Gao Yang. Jinghao was seized and executed, and his household was moved to Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 由是景安獨賜姓高氏，自外聽從本姓。

translations.literal: Thereby Jing'an alone was granted the surname Gao; beyond that, others were left to their original surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby Jing'an alone was granted the surname Gao; beyond that, others were left to their original surnames.

sentences.zh: 永弟種子豫，字景豫，美姿儀，有器幹。

translations.literal: Yong's younger brother Zhongzi Yu, styled Jingyu, had fine looks and capacity.
translations.idiomatic: Yong's younger brother Zhongzi Yu, styled Jingyu, had fine looks and capacity.

sentences.zh: 永安中，羽林監。

translations.literal: In the Yong'an era he served as Supervisor of the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yong'an era he served as supervisor of the Feathered Forest guard.

sentences.zh: 元顥入洛，以守河內功，賜爵永安君。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, for merit in defending Henei he was granted the title Marquis of Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, his defense of Henei earned him the title Marquis of Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 後為濮陽郡守。

translations.literal: Later he became Administrator of Puyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He later became administrator of Puyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 魏彭城王韶引為開府諮議參軍，韶出鎮定州，啟為定州司馬。

translations.literal: Prince of Pengcheng Shao of Wei brought him in as military adviser of the Grand Prefect's office; when Shao went out to garrison Dingzhou, he petitioned to have him made Administrator of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Shao of Wei took him on as a Grand Prefect's military adviser; when Shao went to garrison Dingzhou, he had Yu made administrator of that province.

sentences.zh: 及景安告景皓慢言，引豫言相應和。

translations.literal: When Jing'an denounced Jing Hao's irreverent words, he cited Yu's words as corresponding in agreement.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Jing'an denounced Jing Hao's irreverent talk, he cited Yu's words as corroboration.

sentences.zh: 豫占云：「爾時以衣袖掩景皓口，云 『兄莫妄言』」。

translations.literal: Yu divined and said: "At that time I covered Jing Hao's mouth with my sleeve, saying 'Brother, do not speak rashly.'"
translations.idiomatic: Yu cast lots and said, "At the time I covered Jing Hao's mouth with my sleeve and said, 'Brother, do not speak rashly.'"

sentences.zh: 及問景皓，與豫所列符同，獲免。

translations.literal: When Jing Hao was questioned, his account matched exactly what Yu's divination had listed; he was spared.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing Hao was questioned, his account matched Yu's divination exactly, and Yu was spared.

sentences.zh: 自外同聞語者數人，皆流配遠方。

translations.literal: Several others who had heard the same words were all exiled to distant places.
translations.idiomatic: Several others who had heard the same remark were all exiled to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 豫卒於徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Yu died while serving as Governor of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yu died as governor of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 獨孤永業，字世基，本姓劉，中山人。

translations.literal: Dugu Yongye, courtesy name Shiji, original surname Liu, a man of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Dugu Yongye, courtesy name Shiji, was originally surnamed Liu and came from Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 母改適獨孤氏，永業幼孤，隨母為獨孤家所育養，遂從其姓焉。

translations.literal: His mother remarried into the Dugu clan; Yongye was orphaned young and, following his mother, was raised in the Dugu household, and therefore took their surname.
translations.idiomatic: His mother remarried into the Dugu clan. Orphaned young, Yongye was raised in their household and took their surname.

sentences.zh: 止於軍士之中，有才幹，便弓馬。

translations.literal: He remained among ordinary soldiers, talented and skilled at bow and horse.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from the ranks of ordinary soldiers—capable, skilled with bow and horse.

sentences.zh: 被簡擢補定州六州都督，宿衛晉陽。

translations.literal: Selected and appointed Defender-in-Chief of Dingzhou's Six Provinces, he garrisoned Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen for promotion, he was made defender-in-chief of Dingzhou's six provinces and garrisoned Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 或稱其有識用者，世宗與語悅之，超授中外府外兵參軍。

translations.literal: Some praised his discernment and usefulness; Emperor Shizong spoke with him and was pleased, promoting him beyond normal rank to outer military aide in the Secretariat-Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: Some praised his judgment. Emperor Shizong spoke with him, was pleased, and promoted him past the usual steps to outer military aide in the Secretariat-Directorate.

sentences.zh: 天保初，除中書舍人，豫州司馬。

translations.literal: At the start of Tianbao he was made Secretariat Vice-Director and Administrator of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Tianbao he was made secretariat vice-director and administrator of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 永業解書計，善歌舞，甚為顯祖所知。

translations.literal: Yongye understood writing and reckoning and excelled at song and dance; he was greatly known to Emperor Xianzu.
translations.idiomatic: Yongye was literate and numerate, excelled at song and dance, and came to Emperor Xianzu's notice.

sentences.zh: 乾明初，出為河陽行臺右丞，遷洛州刺史，又轉左丞，刺史如故，加散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Early in Ganming he went out as right assistant commissioner of the Heyang Circuit, was transferred to Governor of Luozhou, then to left assistant with his governorship unchanged, and was given Regular Attendant of the Mounted Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Ganming he went out as right assistant commissioner on the Heyang circuit, became governor of Luozhou, then left assistant while keeping the governorship, and was given regular attendant of the mounted guard.

sentences.zh: 宜陽深在敵境，周人於黑澗築城戍以斷糧道，永業亦築鎮以抗之。

translations.literal: Yiyang lay deep in enemy territory; Zhou men built a fortified stronghold at Heijian to cut the grain route, and Yongye also built a garrison to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyang lay deep in enemy country. The Zhou built a fortified post at Heijian to sever the grain route; Yongye built a matching garrison to hold them off.

sentences.zh: 治邊甚有威信，遷行臺尚書。

translations.literal: He governed the frontier with great prestige and authority and was promoted to circuit senior minister.
translations.idiomatic: He governed the frontier with great prestige and was promoted to circuit senior minister.

sentences.zh: 至河清三年，周人寇洛州，永業恐刺史段思文不能自固，馳入金墉助守。

translations.literal: In Heqing year 3 Zhou troops raided Luozhou; Yongye feared Governor Duan Siwen could not hold on his own and galloped into Jinyong to help defend.
translations.idiomatic: In Heqing year 3 the Zhou raided Luozhou. Yongye feared Governor Duan Siwen could not hold alone and galloped into Jinyong to reinforce the defense.

sentences.zh: 周人為土山地道，曉夕攻戰，經三旬，大軍至，寇乃退。

translations.literal: The Zhou built earthen mounds and tunnels and fought dawn and dusk; after three weeks the great army arrived and the invaders withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou raised earthworks and dug tunnels and attacked day and night. After three weeks the main army arrived and the raiders withdrew.

sentences.zh: 永業久在河南，善於招撫，歸降者萬計。

translations.literal: Yongye had long been in Henan and was skilled at winning over and pacifying; those who came over to him numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Yongye had long served in Henan and was skilled at winning people over; defectors numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 選其二百人為爪牙，每先鋒以寡敵衆，周人憚之。

translations.literal: He chose two hundred as his claws and teeth; each time he led the van with few against many, and Zhou troops feared him.
translations.idiomatic: He picked two hundred as his shock troops and always led the van with few against many; the Zhou learned to fear him.

sentences.zh: 加儀同三司，賞賜甚厚。

translations.literal: He was given Grand Master of Splendid Parallels of Third Rank and very generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He was made grand master of splendid parallels of the third rank and richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 性鯁直，不交權勢。

translations.literal: By nature upright and blunt, he did not associate with the powerful.
translations.idiomatic: Blunt and upright by nature, he kept no company with the powerful.

sentences.zh: 斛律光求二婢弗得，毀之於朝廷。

translations.literal: Hulü Guang sought two maidservants and failed to obtain them; he slandered Yongye at court.
translations.idiomatic: Hulü Guang asked for two maidservants and was refused; he slandered Yongye at court.

sentences.zh: 河清末，徵為太仆卿，以乞伏貴和代之，於是四境蹙弱，河洛人情騷動。

translations.literal: Late in Heqing he was summoned as Grand Minister of Studs and replaced by Qifu Guihe; the four borders then grew weak and the mood in Heyang and Luoyang turned restless.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Heqing he was recalled as grand minister of studs and replaced by Qifu Guihe. The frontiers weakened at once, and Heyang and Luoyang grew restless.

sentences.zh: 武平三年，遣永業取斛律豐洛，因以為北道行臺僕射、幽州刺史。

translations.literal: In Wuping year 3 he was sent to take Hulü Fengluo and was made right vice minister of the Northern Circuit and Governor of Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Wuping year 3 he was sent to take Hulü Fengluo and was made right vice minister of the northern circuit and governor of Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋徵為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was summoned as General-in-Chief of the Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was summoned as general-in-chief of the guards.

sentences.zh: 河洛民庶，多思永業，朝廷又以疆埸不安，除永業河陽道行臺僕射、洛州刺史。

translations.literal: The people of Heyang and Luoyang mostly missed Yongye; the court also found the border unsettled and restored Yongye as right vice minister of the Heyang Circuit and Governor of Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Heyang and Luoyang missed him. With the border again unsettled, the court restored Yongye as right vice minister of the Heyang circuit and governor of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 周武帝親攻金墉，永業出兵禦之。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Zhou personally attacked Jinyong, and Yongye led troops to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Zhou attacked Jinyong in person; Yongye marched out to meet him.

sentences.zh: 問曰：「是何達官，作何行動？

translations.literal: He asked: "What eminent official is this, and what is he doing?"
translations.idiomatic: He called out, "What great man is that, and what is he up to?"

sentences.zh: 」周人曰：「至尊自來，主人何不出看客。

translations.literal: The Zhou men said: "His Majesty has come himself—why does our host not come out to receive the guest?"
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou answered, "His Majesty has come in person. Why does our host not come out to greet his guest?"

sentences.zh: 」永業曰：「客行忽速，是故不出。

translations.literal: Yongye said: "The guest travels too swiftly—that is why I do not come out."
translations.idiomatic: Yongye said, "The guest is moving too fast—that is why I stay inside."

sentences.zh: 」乃通夜辦馬槽二千。
